subject: Intro + Demo: Redwood Inference x Skylo Systems — exec attendance & slot adjustment
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.b@skylo.com>, Tom Harris <tom.h@skylo.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + Demo: Redwood Inference x Skylo Systems — proposing VP/CTO slot

Hi Claire / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time to speak last week. As discussed, we'd love to run a concise demo focused on the latency/cost tradeoffs you mentioned and show a few routing/fallback patterns that map to Skylo's multi-region architecture.

High-level ask: can your VP of Product or CTO join briefly (15–20 minutes) for exec-level context, and we can follow with a 30–40 minute technical walkthrough for engineering and procurement?

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 23 Sep, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 24 Sep, 14:00–14:45
- Thu 25 Sep, 09:30–10:15

I'll bring Lauren (account lead) and Grace (solutions engineer) to run the walkthrough. Attached is our short deck to use as context for the exec intro.

If those windows don't work, let me know an alternate day and whether the VP or CTO is the primary target for the first 15 minutes. Happy to split the session if that makes attendance easier.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood-Intro-Deck.pdf
From: Claire Bennett <claire.b@skylo.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Demo: Redwood Inference x Skylo Systems — proposing VP/CTO slot

Michael — thanks for the note and deck. Tom and I reviewed and have two constraints: our VP (Monica Alvarez) is only available in the morning next week, and our CTO (Ravi Patel) will be traveling on the 23rd and 24th but could dial in for the first 10–15 minutes on the 25th.

Can you do one of the following?
- Move to Tue 23 Sep at 09:00–09:45 (VP available) OR
- Keep 25 Sep but compress to 35 minutes so Ravi can join first 15 then hand off to your SE for the deep dive

We attached an internal availability map for context. Also, procurement will likely want a short follow-up call; I can loop them in after the demo.

Claire
Claire Bennett
Head of Product, Skylo Systems
Attachments: Skylo-MAP.xlsx
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.b@skylo.com>, Tom Harris <tom.h@skylo.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Demo: Redwood Inference x Skylo Systems — proposing VP/CTO slot

Claire — perfect, thanks for the clarity. We can accommodate both asks. Two concrete options to pick from:

Option A (VP-first): Tue 23 Sep 09:00–09:45 PDT — VP Monica Alvarez attends entire session, CTO not required. We'll start with a 12–15 minute exec intro (value / unit economics highlights) then 30 minutes of technical walkthrough and Q&A.

Option B (CTO-short): Thu 25 Sep 09:30–10:05 PDT — Ravi Patel joins first 15 minutes remotely; we compress the technical walkthrough to 20 minutes and record the remainder for Ravi.

Lauren will be your account owner for ops and follow-up; Grace will lead the technical demo. If Option A works, it removes the need for Ravi to be present; if you prefer Ravi in for the first 15, pick Option B.

I'll attach a 1-page run-of-show and we can finalize the calendar after you confirm.

Thanks,
Michael

Hi Claire — quick note from the account side. Happy to run ops for whichever option you choose. A couple of logistics/questions: 

- If we go Option A (23 Sep 09:00), we'll keep the agenda: 15 min exec value, 30 min technical. Can you confirm who from procurement we should copy afterward (email or person)?
- If Option B (25 Sep), we'll tighten the demo to 20 minutes of product surface + 10 minutes of targeted Q&A for Ravi, then follow-up technical deep-dive with your engineers.

I'll be on the invite to manage attendance and recording. Grace — I flagged the run-of-show comments inline in the attached PDF.

—Lauren

Ravi (CTO) will be traveling but has agreed to dial in for the first 10–15 minutes if timelines shift. I've looped in procurement (procurement@skylo.com) for the post-demo next steps.

Please send an updated invite with the agenda and a link to the recording. Also confirm whether you need any pre-demo environment access from us or anonymized telemetry samples.

Looking forward — Claire
